title: 英尺转英寸
problem_statement_md:
编写程序，将英尺转换为英寸并输出结果。
用户输入英尺数值。

**公式**：1英尺= **12**英寸
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Feet to Inches Converter[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You need to create a program that converts feet to inches and outputs the resulting value.
The feet value is provided as the input to the program.
1 foot = [b]12[/b] inches. 

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
5

[b]Sample Output:[/b]
60

[note]The input is an integer.[/note]

code_templates.solution_code:
package main
import "fmt"
func main() {
    var i int
    fmt.Scanln(&i)
    fmt.Println(i*12)
}
